I had a previous appointment that didn’t allow me to get to their office until 2:45. I waited 10 minutes before they had me in an examination room. After an extensive battery of x-rays and whatever else they thought was important, the doctor came in to review my concerns. She was amazing! She was thorough and explained everything so clearly that I understood it. A year ago, maybe a little longer, I came to that office simply because Living in Alva, Florida everything is 30 to 60 minutes away from our home. This office is only about 15 minutes away. I’m thrilled to say that the office staff and the doctors have been the finest I’ve had in years. Thank you for allowing me to comment on the exceptional care that I received on Monday!
